The failing tests and source logic have been investigated, and the intended behavior has been specified as a living requirement in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).

### Summary of Investigation
- **Failing Tests:**
  - [`ZipArchiveInputStreamTest.winzipBackSlashWorkaround`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveInputStreamTest.java#L35-L49)
  - [`ZipFileTest.testWinzipBackSlashWorkaround`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/src/test/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipFileTest.java#L145-L151)
- **Observed Failure:** Archives created by WinZip / Windows tools containing backslashes as path separators (e.g., `ä\` or `ä\ü.txt`) are not normalized to forward slashes, causing path lookups and entry names to retain backslashes instead of conforming to standard ZIP path conventions (`ä/` and `ä/ü.txt`).
- **Living Requirement Created:** [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/requirement.feature) defines the expected black-box behavior for both [`ZipFile`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipFile.java) lookups and [`ZipArchiveInputStream`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/compress_13_group_d_arch/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/compress/archivers/zip/ZipArchiveInputStream.java) stream reads.
